book.name: 2Qorontoose Asaas
book.title: Phawuloosi Qorontoose Asaas Xaafida Nam7anththo Kiita

content: Histtiko tani intteko bishin hayssi taas heedzdzanththo; aydekka gidiin yo7oy minnizay nam7u markkan woykko heedzdzu markkanna.

Inttena beyanaas ta nam7anththo boyssan ta inttenara dashe intte naagettana mala ta inttes minththa yootadiskoshin; ha7ikka qasse haahon daada hayssafe kase nagara ooththidaytassinne hankkoytas minththa yootays; ha7i ta intteko hee simma biikko isttafe oonaska mishettike.
Hessika qasse tanan gididi inttes yootizay Kirstoosa gididayssa intte shaakki eranaas koyzayssa bessees; intte achchan diza Kirstoosi wolqqama attiin laafa gidenna.
Izi masqale bolla kaqettidi daaburan hayqqikokka ha7i qasse Xoossa wolqqan paxa dees; nunikka izara laafata gidikkoka intte gishshas giidi Xoossa wolqqan minni doos.
Intte ammanon minni dizaakkonne eranaas ane intterkka inttena paacci xeellite; Yesus Kirstoosi inttenan dizayssa shaakki eribeekketii? Hessaththo hanontta aggiko intte paacen kundideta guussa.
Nuni paacen kundonttayssa intte shaakki erana gaada hidota ooththays.

Intte iita miish ooththontta mala nuni Xoos woossoos; nuni woossizaykka nu aykkoka dandayzayta gidontta aggikokka intte ubba wode lo7o ooso ooththanaappe attiin nu goobateth inttena bessanaas gidenna.
Nuni tumateththas ooththoos attiin tumappe karera aykkoka ooththana dandayokko.
Nuni daaburanchchata gidiin intte qasse minota gidishin nuna ufayssees; nu woosay intte bolla wosoy bayndayta gidana malassa.

Tani hayssa inttes yeddiza kiitaza inttefe haakka dashe xaafiday hessa gishshassa; hessa malan ta intteko biza wode taas Goday immida aawateththan ta inttena waayisikke; Goday taas Aawateth immiday inttena minththanaas attiin laallanaas gidenna.
Ane ha7i ta ishatoo! Saro diite; intte duussa lo7eththite; ta inttena zoroyssa kaallite; asay issoy issaara sigettite; saron diite; siiqonne saro Goday inttenara gidana.
Siiqo yeereteth yeerettidi issoy issaara sarokettite.
Ammaniza asay wurikka inttena saro gees.
Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa kiyateththi, Xoossa siiqoynne Xillo Ayana issifeteththi inttenara ubbatara gido.
